# Backchannel v0.6.6

Backchannel no longer assumes your meetings are in English. You can tell it
which language to expect, and two new on-device models transcribe German,
French, Spanish, Japanese, Chinese and dozens more without sending audio
anywhere, including with the PII Shield or Privacy First switched on.

## Highlights

- **Meeting language.** Admin -> Transcription & Audio has a Meeting language
  setting, "Detect automatically" by default. When you pick a language, every
  transcription path uses it: on-device Whisper, Gemini and OpenAI transcription,
  and Gemini Live and OpenAI Realtime captions. Models transcribe what is said and
  never translate it.
- **Parakeet v3 for 25 European languages.** A new on-device model covers
  English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish,
  Russian, Ukrainian and 15 more, and detects which one is spoken. It powers
  both the saved transcript and a new experimental on-device live-caption
  option, Parakeet v3 Live, so non-English calls can get private captions. The
  first download is about 0.7 GB.
- **Whisper Large v3 Turbo for everything else.** For languages Parakeet does
  not cover, such as Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Arabic and Hindi, this on-device
  model is far more accurate than Whisper Base. It is several times slower on a
  CPU, so it transcribes the saved transcript only, not live captions. The first
  download is about 1.1 GB.
- **Recommendations follow your language.** The Local Model Fit Test only
  recommends a model that covers the meeting language, and prefers a model
  built for that language over a general one. The Transcription & Audio tab
  warns when the selected model can't transcribe the language you chose.

## Smaller improvements

- Chinese, Japanese and Thai transcripts are no longer discarded as
  one-word noise. Those languages are written without spaces, so short
  segments are now measured in characters.
- Whisper's non-English silence phrases, such as subtitle credits and "thanks
  for watching" in Japanese, Korean and Chinese, are filtered the same way the
  English ones already were.
- The Docker backend image builds again from a clean checkout. A newly
  released speech toolkit had broken the optional Sortformer install.

## Upgrading

An install on v0.5.3 or later updates itself in place and verifies the new
build before applying it. An install on v0.5.2 or earlier needs one manual
download from the release page.

Nothing to migrate. The meeting language starts on "Detect automatically", so
transcription behaves exactly as before until you change it. New models
download only when you select one or run the fit test.
